title: workplan_compact_preview input (native surface)
description: Read-only preview of the exact history selection and archive intent; never applies.

id.description: Workplan id; normalized to lowercase [a-z0-9-] (max 80) before use.

resolvedFindingIndexes.description: Indexes of resolved findings to archive.

noteRollover.description: D.4 (approved 2026-09-30): select notes by rollover instead of noteIndexes. Every note older than the latest keepLatest is archived unless it is pinned: explicitly ([pinned] in its text, or listed in pinNoteIndexes), as a decision record (the words decision/decisions/decided, or the uppercase USER marker), by naming an open step as <phaseId>/<stepId> or quoting an open finding's title, or as one of the latest 3 compaction archive pointers (D.4.2, approved 2026-10-01; older pointer notes roll over like other notes and are archived). Apply needs a fresh checkpoint, so every archived note predates the newest checkpoint. The preview token binds these parameters and the resulting indexes. Cannot be combined with noteIndexes.

keepLatest.description: How many of the newest notes always stay (default 20).

pinNoteIndexes.description: Zero-based indexes of further notes to keep.

expectedHash.description: stateHash from the latest read; binds the write to that exact state.

x-shiori-rules.native: noteRollover cannot be combined with noteIndexes; noteRollover selects the notes
x-shiori-rules.core: noteRollover cannot be combined with noteIndexes; noteRollover selects the notes

x-shiori-core-surface: Native-only tool; core equivalent is workplan_compact with mode=preview.
x-shiori-nested-unknown-keys: noteRollover (D.4) rejects unknown keys like the top level.
